name: thinklight
description: The light is a Mac's camera LED; the agent may be anywhere. Turns the Mac's camera LED into an AI busy light: on while the agent works, off when it's your turn. To light that LED it opens the built-in camera (plus a Studio Display camera when docked) and discards every frame in the callback — no image processing, no recording, no disk writes. Its hooks fire on every turn to write a local session token naming the session id and owning pid; no prompt or response content is read, and nothing but that token's session id and turn id ever leaves the machine — only over ssh, only to a Mac you connected from, and only if you asked for it with `thinklight tunnel setup`. The LED needs a small daemon that this plugin cannot run from inside itself, so on its first session it downloads the matching signed release from this repository's GitHub Releases and installs three programs into ~/.local/bin, then notifies you; `thinklight config bootstrap off` (or THINKLIGHT_NO_BOOTSTRAP=1) turns that off and leaves you to run get.sh or install.sh yourself. Installed on a machine that is not a Mac — a server you ssh into — it puts no binaries and no daemon there, only the CLI, which sends that agent's turns back to the light on the Mac you connected from once that Mac has run `thinklight tunnel setup`. Optional sound stays off until you run /thinklight:unmute; from there `thinklight theme install` swaps in a shared pair of tracks as one package, and /thinklight:theme-current says which one is playing.
